svg.aria-label: finding the bottleneck top down: first end-to-end metrics and the theoretical floor, then server-side metrics, then one step's timeline, and only last the kernels
svg.text: TTFT / TPOT / throughput vs the theoretical floor: which part is slow? slow under every load, or only under high load?
queue length, KV usage, preemptions, cache hit rate, batch size; much "slow" is scheduling and capacity
profiler: CPU scheduling and inputs → GPU forward → sampling → results; is the GPU always busy?
which kernels take the time? how far from each one's roofline? memory-bound or compute-bound?
any layer may give the answer directly; skipping the layers above to look straight at kernels most often ends in optimizing something worth only 5%
